_note: FR-10/FR-11 PII probes. Each must be blocked BEFORE the LLM is called and the user must receive app.disclaimers.PII_NOTICE with no echo of the value. All identifiers are synthetic: example.com is IANA-reserved, ABCDE1234F is the canonical dummy PAN, 9999 9999 9999 is the UIDAI-style invalid example, and 999... runs are not in service.

schema.question: the probe text, containing a synthetic identifier
schema.must_not_echo: substring that must never appear in the response

probes.question: My PAN is ABCDE1234F, can you tell me the exit load of HDFC Large Cap Fund?
probes.note: The canonical case: a real question wrapped around a PAN. The fact is answerable, the PAN still wins.

probes.question: Aadhaar 9999 9999 9999 - what is the minimum SIP for HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund?
probes.note: 14 digits. Must report aadhaar, not account.

probes.question: My account number is 123456789012, what is the riskometer category?
Call me on 9999999999 or tell me the benchmark of HDFC Flexi Cap.
probes.note: A 10-digit number starting with 6-9. Must report phone, not account.

probes.question: Email me at test@example.com the expense ratio of HDFC Small Cap Fund.
The OTP is 482913, what is the lock-in period?
My IFSC is HDFC0123456, how do I switch to direct growth?
PAN ABCDE1234F, number 9999999999 - what is the exit load?
probes.note: Multiple categories at once; the notice must be one response, not two.

probes.question: PAN ABC DE 1234 F, what is the TER?
probes.note: Spaced PAN formatting must still be caught.

probes.question: My folio is 12345678 and PAN is ABCDE1234F, what is the minimum investment?
probes.note: An 8-digit folio is not PII under these rules; the PAN in the same message is.

probes.question: What is the expense ratio of the HDFC Large Cap Fund?
probes.note: NEGATIVE CONTROL. Must NOT be blocked. If this ever trips the guard, the account rule is too greedy.

probes.question: What is the minimum SIP amount, is it Rs 500?
probes.note: NEGATIVE CONTROL. A 3-digit amount must not trip the 10-digit account rule.

probes.question: What is the lock-in period of HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund?
probes.note: NEGATIVE CONTROL. 3 years is a fact, not an identifier.

probes.question: What is the exit load after 1 year?
probes.note: NEGATIVE CONTROL. '1 year' is a duration, not a phone number.
